'''''Arthroceras''''' is a genus of [[snipe flies]] in the family [[Rhagionidae]]. Species of the genus ''Arthroceras'' are mid-sized to large {{convert|4.5|to|13|mm}}, black, grey, or yellowish-colored flies that have a fairly long, tapering [[antenna (biology)|antenna]] consisting of 5–8 [[flagellomere]]s. Within the family Rhagonidae, some authorities place the genus in the subfamily '''Arthrocerinae''', in which it is the only genus.<ref name="Kerr2004">{{cite thesis|last=Kerr|first=Peter H.|year=2004|title=Revision of the Genera of the Rhagionidae of the World (Diptera: Brachycera)|url=https://drum.lib.umd.edu/bitstream/handle/1903/1684/umi-umd-1654.pdf?sequence=1&isAllowed=y|hdl=1903/1684|publisher=[[University of Maryland]]}}</ref>
